extension.description: Use models from your OpenAI-compatible AI relay directly in the Copilot Chat model picker.
command.deleteConnection: WeaveNet: Delete Relay Connection and API Key
command.clearAllConnections: WeaveNet: Clear All Relay Connections and API Keys
configuration.title: WeaveNet for Copilot
configuration.profiles.description: All named global Relay connections are enabled simultaneously and their model catalogs are aggregated. Remote relays must use HTTPS; HTTP is allowed only for localhost and IP loopback addresses. Each profile has an extension-managed UUID and one API key stored only in VS Code SecretStorage. Extra header values are regular VS Code settings and must not contain secrets.
configuration.modelOpenAICapabilities.de: Per-model OpenAI request capabilities. Declare verified support only; reasoning summaries are omitted by default and standard images preserve selected parameters.
configuration.anthropicVersion.descripti: Anthropic protocol version header sent when calling /messages for Claude models.
configuration.openaiPromptCaching.descri: Send prompt_cache_key when model support or a custom cache key is explicitly configured. Model names do not determine support.
configuration.openaiPromptCacheKey.descr: Optional prompt_cache_key and an explicit declaration of Relay support. An explicit model promptCacheKey: false overrides it. Leave empty to generate a workspace key only for models declaring support.
configuration.claudePromptCaching.automa: Use top-level automatic caching when the model declares support; otherwise mark system, tools, and the latest two user messages.
configuration.claudePromptCaching.disabl: Do not send cache_control for Claude requests.
configuration.claudePromptCaching.descri: Claude prompt caching mode. The model automaticCaching capability selects top-level automatic caching without adding block breakpoints.
configuration.claudePromptCachingTTL.des: Anthropic prompt cache lifetime. 1h may improve long-running agent sessions but can cost more than 5m.
configuration.temperature.description: Optional sampling temperature. For OpenAI-compatible requests, temperature takes precedence when top_p is also set.
configuration.topP.description: Optional nucleus-sampling top_p. OpenAI-compatible requests send it only when temperature is not configured.
configuration.requestTimeoutSeconds.desc: Maximum seconds to wait for relay response headers. GET model discovery is retried once; chat POST requests are never blindly retried.
configuration.streamIdleTimeoutSeconds.d: Maximum seconds to wait between streamed response chunks before treating the stream as incomplete.
configuration.debug.description: Write redacted request summaries and Claude cache usage to the WeaveNet output channel. API keys and prompt text are never logged.
configuration.modelNamePrefix.descriptio: Display prefix for models shown in Copilot Chat.
configuration.maxInputTokens.description: Hard upper limit for input tokens advertised to Copilot. Lower this when an upstream OAuth model accepts less context than its model metadata reports.
configuration.maxOutputTokens.descriptio: Max output token count advertised to Copilot and optionally sent as max_tokens.
configuration.sendMaxTokens.description: Send the output token limit. Legacy models use max_tokens; explicit model capabilities can use max_completion_tokens or omit it.
configuration.supportsToolCalling.descri: Advertise tool calling support for relay models.
configuration.supportsImageInput.descrip: Advertise image input support. Enable only if your relay and target models accept image parts in OpenAI chat completions.
configuration.imageInputModels.descripti: Optional regular expressions that force image input on matching models. Model metadata is detected automatically from sub2api and OpenRouter.
configuration.disabledImageInputModels.d: Regular expressions that disable image input even when public metadata says a model supports it. Empty by default.
configuration.visionProxyEnabled.descrip: Allow text-only WeaveNet models to accept images through the explicitly configured installed vision model. Disabled by default. Image bytes, the vision instruction, bounded source-turn user text and image-group layout may be sent to that provider and incur charges. Native vision models bypass the proxy. Successful descriptions can be saved in host conversation metadata for later turns.
configuration.visionProxyModel.descripti: Exact installed native vision model to use, in vendor/id form (for example copilot/gpt-4o). No automatic fallback is used. Do not select a text-only WeaveNet proxy model.
configuration.visionProxyModel.markdownD: Exact installed native vision model to use, in `vendor/id` form (for example `copilot/gpt-4o`). No automatic fallback is used. Do not select a text-only WeaveNet proxy model. Run [WeaveNet: Pick Vision Proxy Model](command:weavenet-copilot.pickVisionProxyModel) to choose from your installed models instead of typing the ID by hand.
configuration.visionProxyPrompt.descript: Optional instruction sent with image bytes and bounded source-turn task/context to the configured vision model. Leave empty for task-focused factual description and OCR. Descriptions use a bounded memory cache and matching metadata in host conversation history; original images are not persisted by the extension, and expired historical images are not automatically reprocessed.
configuration.metadataRefreshHours.descr: How often to refresh cached OpenRouter model metadata, in hours.
configuration.apiType.description: Default API for this connection. Discovered models inherit it unless a model explicitly overrides it. Model refresh never performs paid protocol probes.
configuration.modelApiType.description: Optional API override for this model; otherwise inherits the connection API.
configuration.profiles.baseUrl.descripti: Relay API base URL. Remote relays require HTTPS; HTTP is allowed only for localhost and IP loopback addresses.
configuration.modelContextWindow.descrip: Total input plus output context window; no context-size picker is created.
configuration.modelClaude.description: Native Claude thinking mode and documented effort levels.
configuration.modelClaude.sampling.descr: Explicit sampling support for non-thinking requests. Leave unset when support is unknown.
configuration.modelClaude.forcedToolChoi: Explicit support for Required tool choice (any). New models that reject forced choice must use false.
configuration.modelOpenAI.sampling.descr: Explicit support for temperature/top_p. Reasoning models omit them unless support is declared.
configuration.modelOpenAI.samplingEffort: Only send sampling parameters for these documented reasoning effort levels.
configuration.modelOpenAI.imageCompatibi: Standard preserves supported parameters and image schema. Legacy relay opts into private media_type and image routing hint omissions.
configuration.modelMetadataEnabled.descr: Supplement missing model capabilities and reference pricing from the public OpenRouter catalog. Disable to use only relay metadata and model declarations.
configuration.legacyCapabilities.depreca: Retained for existing installations. Configure toolCalling or imageInput on individual models in the connection; explicit model declarations take precedence.
Supports the Responses input token count endpoint. Used only by the manual token comparison command.
configuration.modelClaude.automaticCachi: Supports top-level cache_control. When caching is enabled, use it instead of explicit block breakpoints.
